title: The Diamond on Green Street
content:
Detective Ryan Cole was working late on a cold and rainy evening when he received an unusual phone call.

A valuable diamond had disappeared from a small but famous jewelry store in the city center. The owner described the diamond as rare, expensive, and extremely valuable. According to him, the thief had escaped only a few minutes earlier.

Ryan immediately drove to the store. It was located on Green Street, next to a quiet bookstore and across from an old bank.

When he arrived, a nervous security guard was waiting outside.

/ Detective, the thief ran in that direction. / the guard said, pointing toward a narrow street.

Ryan looked carefully at the area.

/ Can you show me exactly where he went? / he asked.

The guard nodded.

/ He left the store and went straight for about two blocks. Then he turned left at the large supermarket. After that, he turned right and ran toward the old train station. /

Ryan followed the directions. The streets were dark and almost empty, but he noticed something suspicious near a small café.

A black, leather glove was lying on the ground.

The detective picked it up carefully.

/ This might belong to our thief. / he said.

Ryan continued his investigation. He went straight until he reached a busy intersection. The train station was between a modern hotel and an abandoned warehouse.

Near the entrance, Ryan met a young woman who had seen someone running through the area.

/ He was wearing a dark jacket and a large gray backpack. / she explained. / He looked very nervous. /

/ Which way did he go? / Ryan asked.

The woman pointed toward the warehouse.

/ He turned left after the station. Then he walked past a small park and disappeared behind the old brick building. /

Ryan quickly followed her directions. He walked past the park and turned left. Behind the warehouse, he discovered a narrow, hidden alley.

At the end of the alley, there was a small wooden door.

Ryan opened it slowly.

Inside, he found a tall, frightened man sitting next to several boxes. A shiny object was lying on a table beside him.

The missing diamond.

The man immediately tried to escape.

/ Stop! / Ryan shouted.

The thief ran toward the back door, but the alley was too narrow. He turned right, then left, trying to find another exit. However, Ryan knew the area well.

/ You can't escape. / the detective said. / The police station is only two blocks straight ahead, and officers are waiting outside. /

The thief finally stopped.

Later that night, the diamond was returned to its owner. Ryan looked once more at the quiet streets of Green Street.

It had been a long investigation, but every small detail, dark corner, and narrow street had helped him solve the case.
